item.title: 4.7-magnitude tremor recorded in Baramulla region of J&K
item.description: Earthquake with intensity 4.7 occurred in Baramulla in the Jammu as well as Kashmir area at 5.35 AM on Monday. According to National Centre of Seismology (NCS) it was observed at 10km depth within the region. In announcing the details, PTI stated that it's the epicenter located in Pattan region.

item.title: Sitharaman Quotes Elon Musk On India’s Global Growth Role, Takes Swipe At Opposition
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman cited an Elon Musk post referencing IMF data on India’s growing share in global GDP growth, while urging the Opposition to acknowledge India’s rising economic influence.

item.title: BRS activists stage protest in Siddipet; burn CM’s effigy
item.description: Siddipet: BRS cadres staged a strong protest here alleging that former Chief Minister KCR is being subjected to political harassment under the pretext of an SIT inquiry. item.title: Apple May Launch Two Foldable iPhones, Including Clamshell Variant
